gate_certificate.criterion: BOTH mean paired-seed macro ST-RAE delta AND macro ST-RAE delta of averaged seed42+142 prediction vectors must be strictly below zero on EACH frozen cohort.
gate_certificate.criterion_predeclaration: The averaged-prediction requirement was added before gate outcomes, to match the planned ten-fold-bag seed42+142 submission ensemble.

calibration_limits: Neural inner-OOF checkpoints may be selected using the same inner validation labels.
Calibration cross-fitting over existing OOF predictions is not fully nested base-model cross-validation.
OOF predictions use one inner model per molecule; outer predictions average five models.
Calibration and blend choices must be fitted on development labels only, never these outer labels.
qualifications.development_seen: These cohorts have been inspected during development; repeated selection can overfit their readouts.

holdout_overlap.interpretation: The two evaluation cohorts overlap and are not independent replications.

qualifications.provenance_limit: Hashes bind the supplied artifacts and saved ORX done evidence; this gate does not independently replay training or query remote ORX.
qualifications.seed_confirmation: The second seed measures initialization variability on the same cohorts, not a new independent holdout.
qualifications.statistical_limit: Passing establishes observed improvement under this protocol, not statistical significance or a guarantee on the blinded test.
